summary: Practise PV installation checks, commissioning records and handover evidence. Explore the five-day intermediate training outline.
lede: Solar PV installation verification checks field work against design and safety requirements before handover. Designed for PV installers, electrical technicians and site supervisors, the course develops a structured approach to mounting, cable, polarity, protection and isolation checks. Participants practise safe test sequencing, interpret sample commissioning readings, record defects and prepare inspection and handover evidence using checklists and sample records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who inspect, install, supervise or verify photovoltaic arrays and their electrical connections. It suits practitioners who already work with basic electrical safety and PV components and need a structured approach to field checks, commissioning evidence and handover records.
prerequisites: Bring working knowledge of basic electrical safety, DC circuits and PV system components. Prior experience on a PV installation site is useful. The exercises focus on inspection records, diagrams and sample test readings; they do not require programming.
